```{=html}
<section class="grignan-home">

<style>
@import url('[https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Comfortaa:wght@700&display=swap](https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Comfortaa:wght@700&display=swap)');

/* =====================================
   FOND ET DÉCORATIONS
===================================== */

html,
body,
#quarto-content {
  background-color: #F4F0E8 !important;
}

.grignan-home {
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  color: #293747;
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: auto;
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.grignan-home * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* LAVANDE À DROITE */

.lavande-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  right: 15px;
  bottom: 10px;
  width: 190px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.17;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* ÉPI DE BLÉ À GAUCHE */

.ble-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  left: 8px;
  bottom: 15px;
  width: 175px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.19;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* =====================================
   EN-TÊTE DE PAGE
===================================== */

.gh-page-header {
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 64px 20px 42px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.agir-titre-filigrane {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 48%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 400px;
  max-width: 92vw;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.17;
  pointer-events: none;
  user-select: none;
  z-index: 0;
}

.gh-kicker,
.gh-page-header h1,
.gh-page-header p {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.gh-kicker {
  color: #9b784b;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 3px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.gh-page-header h1 {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: clamp(50px, 9vw, 76px);
  color: #c45c1e;
  margin: 0 0 18px;
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}

.gh-page-header p {
  font-size: 21px;
  color: #666;
  margin: 0 auto;
  max-width: 600px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* =====================================
   TITRE DOSSIER
===================================== */

.gh-dossier-title {
  text-align: center;
  margin: 15px 0 38px;
}

.gh-dossier-title h2 {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 30px;
  color: #26394d;
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.gh-dossier-title p {
  font-size: 19px;
  color: #666;
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* =====================================
   SECTIONS AGIR
===================================== */

.agir-section {
  margin-bottom: 52px;
  padding: 0 10px;
}

.agir-section-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 17px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.agir-number {
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 25px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: white;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.agir-section-title h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 31px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* COULEURS DES PILIERS */

.agir-section.interpeller .agir-number { background: #2b6cb0; }
.agir-section.interpeller h2 { color: #2b6cb0; }

.agir-section.diffuser .agir-number { background: #568239; }
.agir-section.diffuser h2 { color: #43692B; }

.agir-section.rassembler .agir-number { background: #c53030; }
.agir-section.rassembler h2 { color: #c53030; }

/* =====================================
   CARTES
===================================== */

.agir-cards {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}

.agir-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 21px 22px;
  background: #f8f9fa;
  border-radius: 14px;
  border: 2px solid #e2e8f0;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
}

a.agir-card {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.agir-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.agir-section.interpeller .agir-card {
  border-color: #bee3f8;
  background: #f0f9ff;
}

.agir-section.diffuser .agir-card {
  border-color: #b7d7ad;
  background: #f0f7ed;
}

.agir-section.rassembler .agir-card {
  border-color: #fed7d7;
  background: #fff5f5;
}

/* ICÔNES */

.agir-icon {
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  border-radius: 13px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 27px;
  color: white;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.agir-section.interpeller .agir-icon { background: #2b6cb0; }
.agir-section.diffuser .agir-icon { background: #568239; }
.agir-section.rassembler .agir-icon { background: #c53030; }

/* TEXTE DES CARTES */

.agir-card-content {
  min-width: 0;
}

.agir-card-content h3 {
  margin: 0 0 7px;
  font-size: 22px;
  line-height: 1.3;
  color: #1a202c;
}

.agir-card-content p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 18px;
  color: #4a5568;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* =====================================
   BOÎTE À IDÉE SVG + POST-IT
===================================== */

.boite-idee-svg-wrap {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  margin: 18px 0 38px;
  padding: 0 12px;
}

.boite-idee-svg {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 500px;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
}

.postit-mail-link {
  color: #26394d;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.postit-mail-link:hover text {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* =====================================
   RESPONSIVE
===================================== */

@media (max-width: 600px) {

  .gh-page-header {
    padding: 44px 16px 32px;
  }

  .agir-titre-filigrane {
    width: 270px;
    opacity: 0.14;
  }

  .gh-kicker {
    font-size: 13px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
  }

  .gh-page-header h1 {
    font-size: 52px;
  }

  .gh-page-header p {
    font-size: 19px;
  }

  .gh-dossier-title h2 {
    font-size: 25px;
  }

  .gh-dossier-title p {
    font-size: 17px;
    padding: 0 10px;
  }

  .agir-section {
    padding: 0 5px;
    margin-bottom: 42px;
  }

  .agir-section-title {
    gap: 13px;
    margin-bottom: 19px;
  }

  .agir-number {
    width: 46px;
    height: 46px;
    font-size: 22px;
  }

  .agir-section-title h2 {
    font-size: 27px;
  }

  .agir-card {
    padding: 17px 14px;
    gap: 14px;
  }

  .agir-icon {
    width: 46px;
    height: 46px;
    font-size: 22px;
  }

  .agir-card-content h3 {
    font-size: 19px;
  }

  .agir-card-content p {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.45;
  }

  /* FILIGRANES SUR MOBILE */

  .lavande-filigrane {
    width: 110px;
    right: -12px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.12;
  }

  .ble-filigrane {
    width: 105px;
    left: -15px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.13;
  }
}

/* =====================================
   IMPRESSION
===================================== */

@media print {

  .lavande-filigrane,
  .ble-filigrane,
  .agir-titre-filigrane {
    display: none;
  }

}
</style>

BOÎTE À IDÉE SVG + POST-IT
===================================== -->

<div class="boite-idee-svg-wrap">
  <svg class="boite-idee-svg" viewBox="0 0 500 215" xmlns="[http://www.w3.org/2000/svg](http://www.w3.org/2000/svg)" role="img" aria-label="Boîte à idée et post-it : contactez nous fourbanalgrignan@gmail.com">
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id="boisBoite" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e3b66b"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c48e3c"/>
      </linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="toitBoite" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#edd098"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#cfa052"/>
      </linearGradient>
      <radialGradient id="haloAmpoule" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fde047" stop-opacity="0.7"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#fde047" stop-opacity="0"/>
      </radialGradient>
    </defs>

    <!-- Ombre portée douce -->
    <ellipse cx="105" cy="186" rx="74" ry="9" fill="rgba(41,55,71,0.12)"/>

    <!-- Halo lumineux autour de l'ampoule -->
    <circle cx="105" cy="36" r="28" fill="url(#haloAmpoule)"/>

    <!-- Ampoule d'idée -->
    <path d="M105 16 C95 16 88 23 88 32 C88 38 92 42 95 46 L115 46 C118 42 122 38 122 32 C122 23 115 16 105 16 Z"
          fill="#fef08a" stroke="#7a5828" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <path d="M101 46 L109 46 L108 51 L102 51 Z" fill="#7a5828"/>
    <path d="M101 35 L105 27 L109 35" fill="none" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

    <!-- Toit en pente de la boîte -->
    <polygon points="34,74 105,52 176,74 166,82 105,63 44,82"
             fill="url(#toitBoite)" stroke="#7a5828" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- Fente noire -->
    <rect x="74" y="64" width="62" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#293747"/>

    <!-- Corps de la boîte -->
    <rect x="44" y="78" width="122" height="104" rx="12"
          fill="url(#boisBoite)" stroke="#7a5828" stroke-width="2.4"/>
    <!-- Encadrement intérieur -->
    <rect x="55" y="90" width="100" height="80" rx="8"
          fill="#fdfbf7" stroke="#a87c38" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <!-- Petite serrure décorative -->
    <circle cx="105" cy="154" r="5" fill="#c48e3c" stroke="#7a5828" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="103.5" y="154" width="3" height="6" rx="1" fill="#7a5828"/>

    <!-- Texte sur la boîte -->
    <text x="105" y="114" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Comfortaa, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#26394d">BOÎTE</text>
    <text x="105" y="133" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Comfortaa, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#26394d">À IDÉE</text>

    <!-- Petit brin de lavande décoratif à gauche de la boîte -->
    <g transform="translate(18, 120) rotate(-18)">
      <path d="M10 56 Q12 30 16 6" fill="none" stroke="#687D58" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <ellipse cx="16" cy="7" rx="3.5" ry="6.5" fill="#9274A9"/>
      <ellipse cx="12" cy="15" rx="3.5" ry="6" transform="rotate(-25 12 15)" fill="#9274A9"/>
      <ellipse cx="20" cy="17" rx="3.5" ry="6" transform="rotate(25 20 17)" fill="#9274A9"/>
      <ellipse cx="12" cy="25" rx="3.2" ry="5.5" transform="rotate(-20 12 25)" fill="#B49AC6"/>
      <ellipse cx="19" cy="27" rx="3.2" ry="5.5" transform="rotate(20 19 27)" fill="#B49AC6"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Post-it jaune -->
    <g transform="translate(202, 34) rotate(3)">
      <!-- Ombre post-it -->
      <polygon points="5,9 273,4 277,142 3,147" fill="rgba(41,55,71,0.13)"/>
      <!-- Feuille post-it -->
      <path d="M0,4 L268,0 L272,132 L242,154 L0,142 Z"
            fill="#fef08a" stroke="#d4b13a" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <!-- Coin replié -->
      <polygon points="242,154 246,133 272,132"
               fill="#f5d95e" stroke="#d4b13a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <!-- Scotch en haut -->
      <rect x="106" y="-7" width="58" height="16" rx="2"
            fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.78" stroke="#dfd3b0" stroke-width="1.2"/>

      <!-- Texte du post-it -->
      <text x="135" y="62" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Comfortaa', Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#293747">Contactez nous ↴</text>
      <a href="mailto:fourbanalgrignan@gmail.com" class="postit-mail-link">
        <text x="135" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15.5" font-weight="700" fill="#39766b" text-decoration="underline">fourbanalgrignan@gmail.com</text>
      </a>
    </g>
  </svg>
</div>

</section>
```
